scope: Actual account page/runtime/application/SDK with browser DOM and fake native APIs; not WeChat-host or production
flows: accept: real SDK ACK and journal before local-only logout; year and date shown
restart receipt and explicit login cancellation: no duplicate DELETE
receipt storage failure: local retry only, one DELETE
unknown accepted result + explicit new login: old intent retired, new request uses new key
page hide resolves confirmation and returns usable controls without stale dialog
withdrawal during DELETE: late ACK fenced, durable unknown marker retained
